newsitem.title: USA: NY Gov proposes letting parents create schools - NYT.
newsitem.headline: NY Gov proposes letting parents create schools - NYT.

text.p: New York's governor plans to allow parents, teachers and community groups to create small schools financed by taxpayers but independent of local school boards, according to Monday's New York Times.
The plans are included in the budget proposal Governor George Pataki will unveil on Tuesday.
If the education proposal passes, New York would join two dozen states that already permit such schools, the Times said.
Such "charter schools" have drawn criticism from teachers' unions and school boards elsewhere, according to the Times.

The governor also will release a proposal to control state special education spending by eliminating the financial incentives that have encouraged schools to transfer children with mild learning or behavioral problems to expensive segregated classrooms, the paper said.
The budget is also expected to freeze or reduce spending on a number of popular programs to close a projected $3 billion deficit in the fiscal year that begins April 1.
